recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖（非形態圖）：在 blast gate 中，細胞群 CD33 一致陽性，CD13 由弱至中等陽性，表示母細胞為骨髓系（myeloid）表現型。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on blasts: CD13-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Single dominant population with uniform moderate CD33 expression
CD13 expression is heterogeneous, ranging from dim to moderate
Small scattered CD13/CD33 double-negative events in the lower left
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the gated blast population shows a single dominant population with uniform moderate CD33 expression and heterogeneous dim-to-moderate CD13 expression. Only a small minority of events is negative for both markers. This co-expression of CD13 and CD33 establishes a myeloid immunophenotype for the blasts, consistent with a myeloid neoplasm in this GATA2 germline case; lineage and maturation stage require the full panel (CD34, CD117, HLA-DR, monocytic markers).
